source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Test a human digital twin through an explicit bidirectional live-state relationship between a real adult and her full-scale digital counterpart.
subject: An adult emergency planner derived from the supplied portrait and a full-scale translucent digital counterpart sharing her appearance and current body state.
setting: A coastal storm-surge command room with volumetric displays, wearable biosensors, live infrastructure models, and rain-lashed windows.
event: She raises one arm to update an evacuation model while her digital counterpart mirrors the pose and returns a changed physiological and route simulation to her wrist display.
visual_priorities: A readable two-way synchronization loop between physical person and digital counterpart
The same reference-informed appearance and mirrored current pose across real and digital forms
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic photorealistic photograph inside a coastal storm-surge command room at night. An unmistakably adult emergency planner derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair stands before a full-scale translucent digital counterpart with the same appearance and current pose. She raises one arm over a live evacuation model; wearable biosensors send luminous data paths from her body into the counterpart, while a distinct return path carries an updated physiological forecast and rerouted flood simulation back to her wrist display. The counterpart mirrors her gesture but also visualizes internal state layers and predictive changes, making the bidirectional synchronization legible. Rain lashes panoramic windows, miniature coastal infrastructure glows below, and rotating emergency beacons add warm accents to cool volumetric light. Use a medium-wide diagonal composition that keeps the physical woman, digital twin, sensor link, and changed simulation readable in one frame.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Selected a bidirectionally synchronized human digital-twin crisis room as one independent test arm.
